headline: The Wall Street Journal says retailers from QVC to Kohl’s disagree about whether to let AI shopping agents buy from their sites.
score_reason: Pool score 5 lowered by 1: headline only, and the article was first published around 2 Oct 2026, before the 4 Oct cutoff.
importance_line: Shoppers may find some stores open to AI buying tools and others closed to them, but we could not check which retailers or why.
summary: The Wall Street Journal reports that retailers from QVC to Kohl’s are split on agentic shopping, in which AI agents browse and buy on a shopper’s behalf, an article first published around 2 Oct 2026.
notes: Headline only: WSJ paywalled (HTTP 401). Date of 2 Oct 2026 from Google News listing; "Locking the Doors" headline is probably the same piece, unverified.
